info.title: AGENA — Insurance Agent Experience BFF API
info.description: Complete production Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) API serving the AGENA Insurance Agent Lifecycle Platform. Implements session-cookie authentication, CSRF double-submit protection, and standard envelopes.
